summary: New brandable role --ui-text-inverse-muted (Tailwind: text-ink-inverse-muted): secondary ink on --ui-bg-inverse, stepped 35% toward the band and floored at AA against --ui-bg-inverse-hover. Theme zero: #A7A7A7 light (7.14:1 on the band) / #55555A dark (6.70:1). Replaces consumers' unaudited color-mix(… 70%, transparent) (#36).

migration.manual: A brand theme regenerated with resolveThemePair gets the role automatically; a hand-written theme must add it.
